desc: wat2wasm (wabt): WebAssembly text format on stdin, validated binary module on stdout.
usage: POST /v1/svc/cx-wat2wasm {"in_text":"(module (func (export \"f\") (result i32) i32.const 42))"} then GET /v1/b/<out> for the bytes (?raw=1 streams them). Parse or validation errors: wabt's "<stdin>:line:col: error: ..." lines on stdout, exit 1. Default wabt feature set; no debug names.
out: wasm binary bytes (or error lines, exit 1)

tests.in_text:
(module
  (memory (export "m") 1)
  (func (export "add") (param i32 i32) (result i32)
    local.get 0
    local.get 1
    i32.add))
